courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 預鑄混凝土耐震接頭
related.transfer: 可遷移「異常荷載與不成比例倒塌」與「子結構試驗與能量法動力容量」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；預鑄混凝土耐震接頭的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Abnormal loads and disproportionate collapse" and "Subassembly testing and energy-based dynamic capacity" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Seismic connections for precast concrete must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以拉結力、替代路徑、穿孔剪力與懸鏈作用檢核，讓局部破壞不擴散成不成比例的倒塌；預鑄混凝土耐震接頭則以以等同現澆與接合式兩種策略、混合預力接頭、套筒續接與支承長度，讓預鑄構架在地震中可靠傳力並能自行復位為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on tie forces, alternate paths, punching shear and catenary checks that keep local damage from becoming disproportionate collapse; Seismic connections for precast concrete centres on emulative and jointed strategies, hybrid post-tensioned joints, grouted sleeves and seating length that let precast frames transfer seismic force reliably and recentre, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「局部破壞範圍」與「樓板隔板接合器」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到預鑄混凝土耐震接頭，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「ACI 374.1 試驗允收與能量消散比」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Extent of local damage” and “Diaphragm connectors”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Seismic connections for precast concrete, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "ACI 374.1 test acceptance and energy-dissipation ratio", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 結構抗連鎖倒塌設計
history.text: 1968 年倫敦 Ronan Point 角落倒塌後，英國在 1970 年修訂建築法規加入「不成比例倒塌」要求，並在過渡期以 34 kPa 的爆炸壓力作為新建高層住宅的設計值。1995 年奧克拉荷馬市 Murrah 聯邦大樓爆炸與 2001 年世界貿易中心事件之後，美國聯邦總務署與國防部發展替代路徑設計準則，國防部 UFC 4-023-03 於 2009 年發布並持續修訂；NIST 在 2007 年出版 NISTIR 7396 整理抗連鎖倒塌的最佳實務，2008 年完成世界貿易中心 7 號大樓調查，2026 年發布 Champlain Towers South 的技術結論。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: After the 1968 corner collapse at Ronan Point in London, the UK amended its building regulations in 1970 to require resistance to disproportionate collapse, using an interim explosion pressure of 34 kPa for new tall housing blocks. Following the 1995 bombing of the Murrah Federal Building in Oklahoma City and the 2001 World Trade Center attacks, the US General Services Administration and the Department of Defense developed alternate-path design guidelines, with the Department of Defense issuing UFC 4-023-03 in 2009 and revising it since; NIST published best practices on progressive collapse as NISTIR 7396 in 2007, completed its World Trade Center 7 investigation in 2008 and released technical findings on Champlain Towers South in 2026. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

references.scope: 設計準則全文，含風險類別、拉結力公式、0.20 rad 轉角要求與替代路徑程序；課程只引用公式型式。
references.scopeEn: Full design criteria with risk categories, tie-force equations, the 0.20 rad rotation requirement and alternate-path procedures; the course quotes only the form of the equations.

references.title: NIST：降低建築物連鎖倒塌潛勢的最佳實務（NISTIR 7396）
references.titleEn: NIST: Best Practices for Reducing the Potential for Progressive Collapse in Buildings (NISTIR 7396)
references.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
references.scope: 說明風險架構、拉結力、局部抵抗與替代路徑三種方法，以及各國規範回顧與案例。
references.scopeEn: Describes the risk framework, the tie-force, specific local resistance and alternate-path methods, a review of national standards and case studies.

references.title: 維基百科：Ronan Point（英文）
references.scope: Ronan Point 倒塌經過、調查結論與英國法規變更的概覽，作為延伸閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Overview of the Ronan Point collapse, inquiry findings and UK regulatory changes, for further reading.

roles.roleEn: Public collapse investigation reports and progressive-collapse best practices

roles.businessEn: US federal research agency that leads National Construction Safety Team investigations of major building collapses and publishes engineering guidance.

roles.businessEn: Professional society publishing ASCE 7 and related structural engineering standards.

roles.role: 取得 UFC 4-023-03 等抗連鎖倒塌準則全文

roles.businessEn: Design-guidance portal run by the National Institute of Building Sciences that publishes US Department of Defense Unified Facilities Criteria.

courses.connection: 從「結構抗連鎖倒塌設計」的材料、構件、施工或監測延伸到下列公司、業主與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購或背書。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies, owners and institutions related to the materials, members, construction or monitoring of Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement or endorsement.
